## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | The cost's id (mco_…). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `model_cost_override`. One of `model_cost_override`. |
| `id` | `string` | The model cost override's id. |
| `provider` | `string` | Null = this model under any provider. |
| `model` | `string` | The model id or name, as your events send it. |
| `token_type` | `string` | The model cost override's token type. |
| `currency` | `string` | The model cost override's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `unit_amount_decimal` | `string` | Minor units (cents for USD) per `quantity_divisor` units. A decimal string with at most 12 decimal places and no exponent, for example `"0.25"`. |
| `quantity_divisor` | `integer` | The model cost override's quantity divisor. |
| `effective_from` | `string · ISO-8601` | The model cost override's effective from. |
| `effective_to` | `string · ISO-8601` | The model cost override's effective to. |
| `note` | `string` | A note about the model cost override. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the model cost override was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `deleted` | `boolean` | Present and true on a delete response. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The cost row. |
| `404` | No such cost. |

```bash [Request]
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
